scoreTest.verdict: REJECTED: returns do not rise steadily with the score in both halves, or the top bucket loses after costs

rules.name: Tight base breakout
rules.how: uptrend (50 day over 200 day average), 15 quiet days in a range under 15% on drying volume, then a close above that range on 2x volume in the top quarter of the day; buy next open, stop at the range low (risk 5% or less), out after 10 sessions
rules.why: too few trades (20 older, 17 newer; 20 each needed)

rules.name: Holds up while the market falls
rules.how: S&P 500 down 3%+ over 5 days while the stock is down under 1% (or up) on 1.5x volume; next day the market is up and the stock breaks the previous high; stop at the 5 day low, out after 5 sessions
rules.why: lost money in the older half; profit factor 1.18; no better than the S&P 500 over the same days; loses at higher costs (1.2% a trade); could still be luck after testing 17 ideas on the same years (false-discovery check)

rules.name: Second day after a big up day
rules.how: day 0 up 10%+ on 5x volume, closed in the top quarter; day 1 holds above day 0 low, not down over 3%, on less volume; buy a break of the day 1 high on day 2, stop at the day 1 low, out after 5 sessions
rules.why: lost money in the older half; average under zero at 0.8% cost; profit factor 0.93; no better than the S&P 500 over the same days; loses at higher costs (1.2% a trade); could still be luck after testing 17 ideas on the same years (false-discovery check)

rules.name: Strict high tight flag
rules.how: up 20%+ on 5x volume, then 3 to 5 quiet days in a range of 12% or less on falling volume with no down day over 4%; buy a break of the quiet high on 2x volume, stop at the quiet low, out after 5 sessions
rules.why: lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost

rules.name: 20 day high, quality version
rules.how: close at a 20 day high on 2x volume in the top quarter of the day, price 10 USD+, S&P 500 above its 50 day average; buy next open if not 5% above the close, stop at the 10 day low or 2 daily moves (the closer), target 2x the risk, out after 10 sessions
rules.why: lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost

rules.name: Fast mover continuation (next day breaks the jump-day high)
rules.how: up 20%+ on 2x the volume of the 5 days before, closed in the top third of the day; the NEXT day only if it trades above the jump-day high (skip if it opens over 1% above that), stop at the jump-day low or 2 daily moves under the entry (the higher), stop no wider than 18%, target 2.5x the risk, out after 3 sessions
rules.why: lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost

rules.name: Undercut and reclaim (dips under yesterday’s low, closes back above it)
rules.how: uptrend (above the 200 day average, 50 over 200), 5 USD+, 2M USD+ traded; the day trades under the previous day’s low but closes back above it, in the top half of its range; the NEXT day only if it trades above that day’s high (skip if it opens over 1% above it); stop just under the undercut low, no wider than 12%, target 1.5x the risk, out after 5 sessions
rules.why: lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost

rules.name: Deep loser bought at the close, sold the next day
rules.how: down 7% or more on the day, 5 USD+, 5M USD+ traded; buy at the close, sell at the next day’s close (no stop)
rules.why: lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost

rules.name: Deep loser in an uptrend, bought at the close
rules.how: down 7% or more on the day while it was above its 200 day average (50 over 200), 5 USD+, 5M USD+ traded; buy at the close, stop 2 daily moves under it, target 1 daily move over it, out after 5 sessions
rules.why: lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost

rules.name: Most traded and strongest (follow the crowd and the trend)
rules.how: each day: the 100 most traded US companies (20 day average in dollars); of those, the 10 that rose most in 20 days and close above their 50 day average; buy the next open, stop 2 daily moves, out after 5 sessions
rules.why: lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost

rules.name: Bullish candle at the 50 day average in an uptrend (hammer, engulfing, piercing, morning star, harami)
rules.how: uptrend (50 over 200 day average), the low touches within 3% of the 50 day average and the close is above it, a bullish candle on 1.5x the 20 day volume, 5 USD+, 2M USD+ traded; buy next open, stop just under the candle low (no wider than 12%), target 2x the risk, out after 10 sessions
rules.why: lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost

rules.name: Big news gap held for weeks (post-earnings drift style)
rules.how: opens 5%+ above the previous close on 3x the 50 day volume and closes at or above its open (the gain held all day), 5 USD+, 5M USD+ traded; buy the next open if not 3% above that close, stop just under the gap-day low (no wider than 15%), no target, out after 40 sessions
rules.why: lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost

rules.name: Top-10% strength, tight base, breakout (pre-registered, held up to 40 sessions)
rules.how: six-month gain vs the S&P 500 in the top 10% of liquid stocks (5 USD+, 5M USD+ traded a day); above a rising 50 day and the 200 day average; the last 15 sessions within 15% and calmer than before; close above the prior 20 session high on 1.5x the 20 day volume; buy the next open, stop 2 daily moves under it, no target, out after 40 sessions (earnings dates are not in this history)
rules.why: lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost

rules.name: Earnings-style gap, short base, breakout (post-earnings drift, source 1)
rules.how: opens 5%+ above the previous close on 3x the 50 day volume, 10 USD+, 5M USD+ traded; the next 2 to 5 sessions stay in the upper half of the gap day; buy the next open after a close above that base high (within 10 sessions of the gap); stop at the gap-day low or 2.5 daily moves (the closer); sell the next open after a close under the 20 day average, or after 45 sessions
rules.why: lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost

rules.name: Leader pullback continuation (source 2)
rules.how: six-month gain vs the S&P 500 in the top 20% of stocks trading 20M USD+ a day, 5 USD+; above a rising 50 day average that is above the 200 day; 3 to 10% under its highest close of the last 20 sessions; closes above the previous day high on above-average volume; buy the next open unless it is more than 1 daily move above the close; stop at the lower of 2.5 daily moves or the 10 day low, skipped if over 10% away; sell the next open after a close under the 20 day average, or after 40 sessions
rules.why: lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost

rules.name: Pullback 38-50% in an uptrend, quiet volume, reversal day (source 3)
rules.how: close above a 50 day average that is higher than 10 days ago; the close has given back 38.2% to 50% of the move from the 40-to-5-day low to the 20 day high; volume today not above its 20 day average; today closes above yesterday’s high, or up with the close in the top 40% of the day; 5 USD+, 2M USD+ traded; buy next open, stop 0.5% under the 5 day low (12% or less), sell on a close under the 20 day average or after 20 sessions
rules.why: lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost

rules.name: Volume build-up near the high
rules.how: chosen on the older half from 96 versions: last 5 days’ volume 3x the 20 days before, 5 day change +0% to +18%, close within 5% of the 25 day high, price 20 USD or less; buy next open, stop -10%, target +20%, out after 8 sessions
rules.why: lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost

text:
HUNTING LAB, 2026-10-19
17 new ways to catch moves, each a complete trade, tested on the whole US market 2021-10-12 to 2026-10-19 (collapsed stocks included), 0.8% cost. Rules fixed in advance (the build-up version is chosen on the older half only); each must pass in BOTH halves.

REJECTED (lost money on the newer half even at the lowest cost): Strict high tight flag -2.1%; 20 day high, quality version -1.0%; Fast mover continuation -1.1%; Undercut and reclaim -1.0%; Deep loser bought at the close, sold the next day -0.8%; Deep loser in an uptrend, bought at the close -0.6%; Most traded and strongest -0.7%; Bullish candle at the 50 day average in an uptrend -0.9%; Big news gap held for weeks -1.2%; Top-10% strength, tight base, breakout -1.4%; Earnings-style gap, short base, breakout -1.3%; Leader pullback continuation -0.7%; Pullback 38-50% in an uptrend, quiet volume, reversal day -0.7%; Volume build-up near the high -1.3%.

NOT PROVEN: Tight base breakout
  older half: 20 trades, 15% won, average -5.8%, profit factor 0.08
  newer half: 17 trades, 6% won, average -5.3%, profit factor 0.07, stopped out 29%
  too few trades (20 older, 17 newer; 20 each needed)
NOT PROVEN: Holds up while the market falls
  older half: 1182 trades, 36% won, average -0.9%, profit factor 0.66
  newer half: 663 trades, 48% won, average +0.4%, profit factor 1.18, stopped out 13%
  lost money in the older half; profit factor 1.18; no better than the S&P 500 over the same days; loses at higher costs (1.2% a trade); could still be luck after testing 17 ideas on the same years (false-discovery check)
NOT PROVEN: Second day after a big up day
  older half: 270 trades, 37% won, average -0.8%, profit factor 0.80
  newer half: 226 trades, 38% won, average -0.3%, profit factor 0.93, stopped out 37%
  lost money in the older half; average under zero at 0.8% cost; profit factor 0.93; no better than the S&P 500 over the same days; loses at higher costs (1.2% a trade); could still be luck after testing 17 ideas on the same years (false-discovery check)

Market type check: no rule made money in rising markets in both halves.

Buying a random stock for 10 days, newer half: 147552 trades, 43% won, average -0.6%, profit factor 0.85.

EXIT TEST on the same quick-dip entries (24112 + 27441 trades)
  current exit (5 day average or 5 days): older 24112 trades, 49% won, average -0.6%, profit factor 0.66 | newer 27441 trades, 50% won, average -0.5%, profit factor 0.74
  take half at +1 daily move, let the rest run (trailing stop, up to 30 days): older 24112 trades, 49% won, average -1.0%, profit factor 0.63 | newer 27441 trades, 53% won, average -0.9%, profit factor 0.69
  RESULT: KEEP THE CURRENT QUICK EXIT.

QUICK-DIP FILTERS (which conditions make dips work on the whole market; older | newer half, 0.8% cost):
  up+strong+deep: 1211 trades, 52% won, average -0.5%, profit factor 0.73 | 1443 trades, 52% won, average -0.5%, profit factor 0.81
  up+strong: 4544 trades, 52% won, average -0.4%, profit factor 0.79 | 5404 trades, 53% won, average -0.4%, profit factor 0.84
  strong+deep: 2269 trades, 51% won, average -0.6%, profit factor 0.73 | 2276 trades, 55% won, average -0.2%, profit factor 0.92
  strong: 7679 trades, 51% won, average -0.5%, profit factor 0.75 | 7826 trades, 55% won, average -0.2%, profit factor 0.93
  up+deep: 4686 trades, 50% won, average -0.6%, profit factor 0.67 | 5930 trades, 49% won, average -0.6%, profit factor 0.70
  up: 16008 trades, 49% won, average -0.6%, profit factor 0.64 | 20114 trades, 49% won, average -0.6%, profit factor 0.70
  deep: 7575 trades, 50% won, average -0.6%, profit factor 0.69 | 8555 trades, 50% won, average -0.5%, profit factor 0.75
  RESULT: no filter passed: quick trades stay restricted (strict gate) until one does.

PERSISTENCE TEST (quick dips): 8 stocks passed on their own older-half record (15+ trades, +1.5% average, half won).
  newer half, those stocks: 73 trades, 53% won, average -1.5% | all other stocks: 27368 trades, average -0.5%
  RESULT: NOT ENOUGH TRADES.

SCORE TEST (source 3 multi-signal score, 5 sessions after the next open, 0.8% cost), by score 0-0.20 | 0.2-0.40 | 0.4-0.55 | 0.55-0.75 | 0.75-1.00
  older: -0.7% (1203444) | -0.8% (177637) | -0.9% (30545) | -1.0% (1145) | n/a
  newer: -0.6% (1202655) | -0.6% (190137) | -0.7% (32591) | -0.8% (1140) | n/a
  RESULT: REJECTED: returns do not rise steadily with the score in both halves, or the top bucket loses after costs.

No new way passed. Nothing to act on. The lab repeats every Sunday as new days come in.
Not tested here (no history to test on): Reddit or YouTube mentions plus a breakout, and news-tag rules. Those are scored forward instead (sources, movers journal).
Daily prices only; fills at the open or the stated level are assumed. Research, not an order. Not financial advice, not a halal ruling.
